observations: Mind2Web HF dataset osunlp/Mind2Web revision 17ece8eb89862368edc0cc806acee6fca5163474 contains only 'train' split (1009 tasks, 73 websites). Official test_website and test_domain splits are NOT available on HuggingFace.
WebArena-Verified v2 dataset is NOT available on HuggingFace (repo 'web-arena/web-arena-verified' returns 404) or GitHub.
TF-IDF->k-means pipeline verified operational: k=50 (min(50, floor(1009/20))), vocab size 1655, 50 clusters, max cluster fraction 10.7% (no collapse >40%).
Text cleaning verified: top 100 TF-IDF features contain no URL/domain leakage tokens.

Website-label shuffle null (proxy, 100 shuffles) is degenerate: all shuffles yield overlap=1.0 because k-means assigns all test tasks to existing train clusters. This confirms the null distribution cannot be properly constructed without official holdout splits.
EXP-INTEL-35697055679 (MIXED, audit PASS) established: WebArena-Verified v2 defines exactly one shopping store (192 tasks, 49 templates, 36 families), cross-store overlap is vacuous null not 0.0.
EXP-INTEL-35725763380 (REVISE) established: Mind2Web cross-website overlap measurement is methodologically non-compliant; 73/3 vs spec 137/31 divergence noted.

Per spec.json falsifier clause: 'MEASUREMENT_INVALID if ... official Mind2Web splits are not available' and per prereg.md: 'If HF dataset revision lacks 3-way splits, record MEASUREMENT_INVALID with dataset_revision hash'.
validity_notes: MEASUREMENT_INVALID per spec.json falsifier: official Mind2Web splits (test_website, test_domain) are NOT available on HuggingFace. Dataset revision 17ece8eb89862368edc0cc806acee6fca5163474 only provides 'train' split.
MEASUREMENT_INVALID per spec.json falsifier: WebArena-Verified v2 data is NOT available on HuggingFace or GitHub.
The pipeline construction (TF-IDF->k-means) is verified operational but cannot produce valid holdout overlap measurements without official splits.

The proxy website-label shuffle null is degenerate (all overlap=1.0), confirming that the null distribution cannot be properly estimated without the official train/test_website/test_domain split structure.
This measurement invalidity is due to substrate unavailability, not scientific falsification. Infrastructure failure is not a scientific negative.
The three prior divergences flagged by EXP-INTEL-35725763380 (coarse 33-heuristic vs TF-IDF k-means, synthetic 60/40 shuffle vs official splits, 73/3 vs spec 137/31) remain unresolved.

Per the director mandate (allocation.action=PIVOT, parent_handoff_disposition=SUPERSEDE), this experiment tests C-CROSSSITE next_gate (true website holdout without site identity leakage). The inability to access required datasets means the claim cannot be tested at this time.
